sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:45 – 14:30)
items: Equipment: 4x Keys, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Body Vests, 1x Ops Phone, 2x Cameras. Both body camera chargers were missing.
Echo Route commenced. Welfare check completed inside Starbucks. All clear.
Welfare check completed inside Localito Convenience Store. All clear.
Welfare checks completed inside McDonald's Queen Street, 77 Convenience Store, and Mid City. All clear. Security presence maintained before moving along.
Welfare check completed at Remedy Coffee. All clear.
Arrived at Aotea Square check-in. Full sweep commenced around the location. No issues found.
Security presence maintained while awaiting response calls or incidents.

Response call from McDonald's Britomart regarding a male sleeping inside the store. Assistance requested to wake him and move him along. Guards left standby at Aotea Square and patrolled down Queen Street.
Arrived at McDonald's Britomart. Guards woke the POI and asked him to leave. Individual complied without issue.

Arrived at Commercial Bay check-in. Full sweep completed and welfare checks commenced on stores. All clear. Well-known elderly female, Vicky, was present yelling to herself near Adidas. Guards advised her to keep her volume down and maintain public peace.
Arrived at Kiwibank check-in. Welfare checks completed inside The Coffee Club and 77 Convenience Store. All clear.
Arrived at bottom of Fort Street check-in. Welfare checks completed inside Smiley Mart Convenience Store and Auckland Harbour Suites. All clear.
Arrived at Wilson Carpark, Fort Street. Scoped for issues. All clear. Guards proceeded towards HQ to debrief Team 2 while patrolling up High Street and checking stores.
Freyberg Place and Women's Memorial Hall scoped. No issues found.
Arrived at Chancery Square check-in. Quick walkthrough completed. No issues found.
Response call from Unichem Pharmacy regarding street vagrants sitting and sleeping in front of the store. Assistance requested to move them along.
Arrived at HQ. Team 2 deployed and debrief commenced before both teams began route sectors.

Team briefing: Team 1 to cover the lower CBD sector, Team 2 the upper CBD sector. Complete welfare checks on all stores and collect reports of issues from recent weeks. Maintain presence in theft-prone areas and locations of interest.

Arrived at Unichem Pharmacy. The POI who owned the trolley and belongings was not present. Another male street person insisted on moving the belongings for him. Guards advised him to keep the area clean and tidy.
Welfare checks completed inside Woolworths and Chemist Warehouse Victoria Street. All clear.
Arrived at Victoria Street and Albert Street. Welfare checks completed at:
Arrived at top of Victoria Street check-in. Welfare checks commenced along stores and businesses. All clear.
Security presence maintained while awaiting response calls.
Welfare check completed inside The People's Barista. All clear.
Arrived at Cathedral Church. Walkthrough completed around Federal Square. No issues found.
Arrived at Albert Street and Wyndham Street. Welfare checks completed inside Good To Go Supermarket, Hollywood Cafe, and Barclay Suites. All clear. Patrol continued down Albert Street.
Welfare checks completed inside Albert Mart Convenience Store and Discount Dairy. All clear.
Arrived at Customs Street and Albert Street intersection. All clear.
Welfare checks completed inside Metro Woolworths and Aotea Gifts. All clear.
Welfare check completed at OK Gift Shop. All clear.
Arrived at Commercial Bay check-in. Full sweep completed. No issues found. Security presence maintained.
Management reported monks in the CBD allegedly scamming people for money. Guards remained alert and were advised to contact Police if located.
Left standby due to no visible issues. Patrol continued around the location.
Welfare check completed at 77 Convenience Store on Commerce Street. All clear.
Arrived at Commerce Street and Customs Street. Arrived at Kiwibank check-in and welfare checks completed within stores in the area. All clear.
Arrived at bottom of Fort Street check-in. Welfare checks completed inside Giapo, Auckland Harbour Suites, Sienna Cafe, Smiley Mart Convenience Store, Chargrill, and surrounding stores. All clear.
Arrived at Wilson Carpark. Scoped for street vagrants and welfare checks completed. All clear. Guards proceeded to HQ for route sector changeover with Team 2.
Arrived at HQ. Debrief with Team 2 completed.
Both teams deployed back onto patrols.

Response call from PB Tech regarding a female who committed theft approximately five minutes prior. Photo description to be attached and posted to Auror. Team 2 notified and sent to response location.
Welfare checks completed at Yoghurt Story, Yes 24 Convenience Store, Daiso Japan, and Burger Fuel. All clear.
Welfare check completed inside Metro Entertainment City. Walkthrough completed to ensure no vagrants or issues.
Welfare check completed at Jack's Fried Chicken. All clear.
Arrived at Aotea Square check-in. Full walkthrough completed. All clear.
Response call from Police regarding an incident at Chancery Square on 31/05 at approximately 06:00 involving a female who had been assisted by one of the guards in getting an Uber home.
Ops phone battery running low. Guards prepared to return to HQ for charging.
Arrived at top of Mayoral Drive. Checked thoroughly. All clear.
Welfare check completed inside Queens Food Court. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Munster Inn and Nando's. All clear.
Response call from 229 Queen Street regarding a female sitting in front of the store. Assistance requested to move her along.
Response call from 95 Queen Street regarding a male yelling and screaming at members of the public. Team 2 deployed.
Response call from Mountain Warehouse regarding a male who had recently stolen a jacket and had returned to the store. Team 2 notified and prioritised the matter.
Arrived at 229 Queen Street. Guards asked the female POI to move along due to complaints raised by the store manager. She complied without issue.
Arrived back at HQ. Lunch break commenced while preparing for afternoon shift changeover.

sections.title: Day Shift — Team 2 (09:00 – 17:00)
items: Team 2 deployed and stood by for debrief with Team 1.
Debrief with Team 1 completed. Team 2 commenced welfare sweeps up Queen Street while Team 1 patrolled down Queen Street.
Welfare sweeps up Queen Street completed. No issues reported by local stores.
Welfare sweep along Aotea Square completed. All clear. Patrol continued towards Elliott Street.
Welfare sweep along Elliott Street completed. All clear. Team proceeded to Victoria Street.
Welfare sweeps on Victoria Street and Federal Street completed. No issues reported. Team proceeded to Lorne Street.
Welfare sweep along Lorne Street completed. No issues reported by stores.
Welfare sweep up Queen Street completed. All clear. Security presence maintained around upper Queen Street.
Welfare check completed at Auckland Library. All clear.
No response calls to report. Team proceeded back to HQ for route changeover.
Route changeover with Team 1 completed. Response call from PB Tech regarding theft from the store. Team 2 proceeded to PB Tech.
Arrived at PB Tech. Team obtained information from staff regarding the theft.
Information obtained and footage sent to Ops phone. Last known direction of the POI unknown. Team 2 and Team 1 completed full sweeps of lower and upper Queen Street. No further issues.
Full sweep around lower Queen Street completed. No sign of the POI. Team stood by at Commercial Bay for response calls.
Response call from Mountain Warehouse requesting assistance with a suspicious individual in store. Team proceeded to the location.
Team stood by at Mountain Warehouse while waiting for the POI to come out of the changing room.
POI exited the changing room. When requested by HOTC, POI was compliant with a bag search for any items that may have been taken.
No items from Mountain Warehouse were located on the POI. POI was moved along from the store. No trespass notice issued. Team proceeded to 95 Queen Street for assistance.
Arrived at 95 Queen Street. Staff advised the reported POI had no incident with store staff, but were concerned about public peace and welfare in the area.
Vagrant moved along. No further issues reported. Team completed a full sweep around Commercial Bay and returned to HQ for a break and to charge personal phone for reports.
Debrief with Team 1 and route changeover completed. Team 2 commenced patrol up Queen Street.
Welfare sweep completed along Queen Street, Lorne Street, Aotea Square, and Elliott Street. All clear. Team stood by for response calls from Team 1.
Response call from Team 1 regarding a theft from Cotton On. Team 1 requested Team 2 attempt to intercept the POI, last seen running up Queen Street towards Aotea Square.

Team 2 was unable to intercept or locate the POI after a full sweep of upper Queen Street. Team attended Cotton On to apologise for being unable to apprehend the thief. Team proceeded back to HQ for stand down.
Team 2 stood down. No further issues to report.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:37 – 22:30)
items: Equipment handover: 4x Keys, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 2x Radios, 1x Ops Phone, 2x Cameras, 1x Charger.
Afternoon shift stood by to charge Ops phone after it died due to low battery.
Ops phone reached 39%. Alpha Route commenced.
Arrived at Victoria Street East and Queen Street HQ check-in. Welfare checks completed at:
Response call from Jess at Heart of the City regarding a group of rowdy individuals heading down Victoria Street West towards ANZ. Assistance requested to intercept and calm them if required.
Arrived at ANZ and stood by to intercept the group. Team 2 headed towards upper Queen Street.
Group of individuals not located. Guards remained on standby in case they were seen.
Call from Pop Mart regarding a repeat offender inside the store. Assistance requested to stand by until she left and then confront her.

While on standby at Pop Mart, response call from Cotton On regarding a female who stole multiple tops from the rack and was heading up towards upper Queen Street. Team 2 contacted to keep watch and intercept. Female described wearing a purple top and carrying a green bag.
Team 2 advised the female was not intercepted and would attend Cotton On to speak with management and retrieve a photo of the suspect.
While on standby at Pop Mart, the female attempted to leave. Guards approached her with staff regarding previously stolen items. She agreed to pay for them.
Guards remained on standby at Pop Mart.
Female paid for items stolen previously. Guards resumed routes.
Welfare checks completed at Oakley, T2 Tea, Montblanc, Westpac, Infosys, and The Hub. All clear.
Arrived at Commercial Bay check-in. Full sweep completed. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at McDonald's Britomart, Starbucks, Hollywood Cafe, Daily Bread, Deli & Bakery, and Four Square. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Adidas and Movenpick Hotel. All clear.
Alpha Route ended. Echo Route commenced.
Arrived at Queens Arcade check-in. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Q Convenience Store, Western Union Money Exchange, Cookes, Fable, Origani, and Quest. All clear.
Welfare check and building sweep completed at Imperial Lane. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Pocket Park, Partridge Jewellery, BNZ building entrance on Shortland Street, and BNZ Place. All clear.
Arrived at Shortland Street and Queen Street check-in. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Shortland Street Convenience Store and Taco Bell. All clear.
Guards returned to conduct building sweep.
While en route, response call from Woolworths security regarding a male begging outside who they wanted moved along.
The individual saw guards approaching and left. Guards spoke with staff inside and conducted welfare check. All clear.
Guards returned to HQ for building sweep.
Echo Route temporarily ended to conduct building sweep.
Guards stood by to charge Ops phone. Battery shown on camera at 10%.
Ops phone reached 35%, sufficient to recommence Echo Route.
Welfare checks commenced on stores still open after trading hours.

Arrived at Darby Street and Queen Street check-in. Welfare checks completed at Celine Mediterranean Cuisine, Mali Thai, Pizza Club, Tandoori, Domino's Pizza, Freshmarket Store, and Wilson Carpark food stalls. All clear.
Arrived at top of Victoria Street and Federal Street. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Mr Tacos, The Fiddler, Hell Pizza, JD Convenience Store, Casa Victoria, Kebab Time, and Sky Mart Convenience Store. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Lord Nelson's Steak House and Woolworths Victoria Street West. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Dunkin Donuts, Hazy Tiger, BBQ King Restaurant, Midtown Mini Supermarket, and City Life. All clear.
Arrived at Chancery Square and Freyberg Square. Full sweep completed. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Obar, Caravan Serai, Square Bar, Krispy Kreme, Pocha, Mamak Malaysian Restaurant, Jump Rice Chancery, and Oh My Croffle. All clear.
Echo Route ended. Beta Route commenced.
Welfare checks completed along Lorne Street towards Aotea Square. All clear.
Arrived at Lorne Street and Wellesley Street East check-in. All clear.
Walkthrough completed at Auckland Library. All clear.
Arrived at Skyworld Entertainment Centre and Aotea Square check-in. All clear.
Welfare check completed at Father Ted's. All clear.
Welfare check completed at Elliott Stables. All clear.
Lunch break completed. Guards stood by for changeover to night shift.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Welfare checks completed at Britomart and Commercial Bay. All clear.
Welfare check completed at carpark next to Chemist Warehouse. All clear.
Upper Queen Street checked. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Aotea Square and Mayoral Drive. All clear.
Welfare check completed at 77 Convenience Store on Victoria Street. All clear.
Welfare check completed at Albert Mart Convenience Store. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Customs Street and Custom Mart Convenience Store. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Fort Lane, Fort Street, and Jo & Joe. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at High Street and High Street Supermarket. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Chancery Square, Freyberg area, and upper High Street. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Lorne Street and Auckland Library. All clear. Delta Route complete.
Checks completed at Darby Street and Elliott Street. All clear.
Patrol completed up Victoria Street. All clear.
Welfare check completed at 77 Convenience Store. All clear.
Patrol completed along Federal Street towards Wyndham Street. All clear.
Patrol completed down Wyndham Street towards Queen Street. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Q Convenience Store and Custom Mart. All clear.
Patrol completed through Fort Lane, Fort Street, and bottom of High Street. All clear.
Welfare check completed at High Street Supermarket. All clear.
Full sweep completed around Chancery Square and Freyberg Square. All clear. Echo Route complete.
Response call from McDonald's Queen Street.
Arrived on site. A group of vagrants were sleeping out front of the store. Guards asked them to move along and they complied.
Two vagrants were arguing. Guards calmed them down and moved them on.
Guards stood by to maintain visible presence.
Returned to HQ to charge Ops phone and remained on standby for response calls.
Night shift concluded. Handover to morning shift completed.
